- DocuSign authority confirmation for acceptance of our vendor terms (we'll send an envelope).

Can you confirm who from Redwood will be the owner, and whether you need a temporary upload window vs. an ongoing account? We're aiming to complete evidence collection by next Friday (2027-12-24).

[Attachment: SIG-Questionnaire-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the SIG. Happy to get this over the finish line fast.

Short answers: 
- Portal owner: we'll provision an account for Karthik Iyer (Security Liaison) in Vendr and give him "Profile Admin" so he can upload artifacts and manage Q&A.
- DocuSign: I'll escalate to our legal lead to confirm the signer; we typically have a VP-level sig for commercial agreements. We can accept the DocuSign envelope and I'll share the envelope link back.
- Timeline: 2027-12-24 is tight but possible if we get the upload window and access today. If you prefer a short-lived upload-only account (48–72 hrs) we can do that and have Karthik complete the upload + answer the SIG items.

Karthik / Monica — can you confirm you can take ownership for the uploads and whether you want a permanent portal account or a temporary upload window for BrightPeak? Also flag anything in the attached SIG that looks like it will need additional evidence (e.g., KMS key rotation artifacts or SOC 2 report redaction).

Thanks Marcus — that works.

We prefer a permanent portal owner so buyers can re-validate items without asking for new accounts. If you must do a temporary window, 72 hrs is fine.

DocuSign: I'll send the envelope now and mark the signer as "Authorized Signatory". If there's a VP-level signer who needs to be added as an alternate, please confirm by EOD.

Two clarifications on the SIG: 
- Under "Encryption at rest", we'll accept a high-level statement plus a KMS rotation date and a redacted key usage log.
- For "Vendor personnel access", we need role lists and whether access is MFA-protected (screenshot is fine).

I've attached the SIG again for your security team's reference.

Elena / Marcus — looping in final steps from security ops.

Plan: 
1) Portal access: we will create a permanent Vendr owner account for "karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com" with Profile Admin and SSO linked. I'll send the invite link in 10–15 minutes. Please accept and confirm BrightPeak has view/upload rights.

2) Evidence package: I'll upload the following artifacts once the account is active:
   - SOC 2 Type II (redacted)
   - KMS rotation statement + last rotated date (text)
   - Access control role list (CSV) and screenshots of MFA enforcement
   - Sample syslog retention policy (PDF)

3) DocuSign: Marcus — please confirm the authorized signer. If you want, I can also sign a limited authority attestation for upload (not the commercial SOW).

4) Temporary creds: we will not use temporary creds for this profile; SSO + account-based upload is preferred. If BrightPeak requires an ephemeral upload token for automation, we can provide a 72-hr pre-signed link — ask and we'll generate.

Attachments I'm about to upload: SOC2-Redacted-202706.pdf, KMS-Rotation-Statement.txt, access-roles-202712.csv (I'll include them in Vendr).

Estimated ETA: uploads + SIG Q&A answers by 2027-12-20 EOD. If BrightPeak needs everything by 2027-12-24, we can hit that with the permanent account path.

Elena — feel free to drop the DocuSign envelope link here (or I can watch for the notification).

Thanks,
